description: An MCP server that watches a household's insurance policies: it ingests declarations pages (JSON or simple text) into a local policy graph where every field carries provenance, runs an expiry radar over renewals, premium dues, grace-period ends, escrow proof deadlines and enrollment windows, and reports coverage gaps (uncovered assets, duplicate coverage, premium spikes). v0.1 is phase B0: READ/WATCH ONLY, local stdio, no network calls, synthetic fixtures only. It does not insure, bind, advise, shop, or file claims. Alert windows may only be tightened, never loosened (the Vigil rule, encoded and tested). Every ingest, radar run and gap run appends a hash-chained receipt.
